hypothesis: Partial is better represented by visible requested-edit progress without complete fulfillment than by a single interval on the minimum of all rubric scores.

data.model_outputs: Existing rubric_lite_v4 judgments only; no model calls are authorized for this experiment.

validation.threshold_candidates: observed score values plus epsilon, fitted inside each training fold
validation.baseline: minimum-score two-cutpoint Rubric-Lite under identical outer folds
validation.selection_policy: Select one progress definition on EditInspector only, then evaluate that fixed definition on ImagenHub. Threshold values may be fitted per target domain; the rule definition may not change.

advancement_gate.action_if_passed: Implement the fixed progress definition as an optional Rubric-Lite calibrator and preserve minimum-score mode as the compatibility default.
advancement_gate.action_if_failed: Do not add runtime complexity. Record the negative result and retain the minimum-score calibrator.
